issue.title: Step records carry experiment and variant
issue.spec:
## Goal

The daemon's step record and its Dispatch reader carry `experiment` and `variant`.

## Requirements

:::requirement{#r1}
**R1.** A step record read through the daemon's API names the experiment and the variant it ran under. From: the issue.
:::

documents.name: verification.md
documents.body:
# Verification

:::check{#k1 surface="api" run="go test -run 'TestStepRecord' ./internal/api/ ./internal/dispatch/" when="before_merge" negative_control="A step record without experiment fails the reader test."}
The daemon's step record and its Dispatch reader carry `experiment` and `variant`.
:::
